Hero.title: The History of Emerald Gang
Hero.description: From a regional sports society's senior side to bronze in the Premier League — a journey through dissolution, revival, and a return to the top level of Ukrainian football.

Timeline.heading: Club timeline
Timeline.description: Ten turning points that shaped the club's history — from its first match to the highest finish in the top division.

events.title: Club founded
events.description: The senior team was formed under the regional council of the "Avanhard" sports society. A year later it took the field for the first time in the USSR championship under the name that began our history.

events.title: Championship year
events.description: Playing under a different name, the team becomes champion of Ukraine among physical culture collectives — still the brightest page of the club's Soviet-era history.

events.title: Final match and dissolution
events.description: The club withdraws from competition after financial difficulties. A dark page in the chronicle — but, as time would show, not the last one.

events.title: New name: Emerald Gang
events.description: The club officially reclaims its historic name and emerald-and-gold kit — colors that become the team's calling card for years to come.

events.title: Championship bronze
events.description: April 24 will forever remain in the club's chronicle: for the first time in its history dating back to 1959, the team wins bronze medals in the Premier League.

people.name: Ruslan Rotan
people.description: Led the team to historic UPL bronze, building a style of play recognized across the country.

people.name: Yuriy Kalytvyntsev
people.description: Under his leadership the club rose from the First League to its debut in the top division.

people.name: The 1967 squad
people.description: Sixteen footballers whose names stand at the origin of every future triumph of the club.

Quote.text: We've come a long way from a regional side to national bronze — and every season we prove that for Zhytomyr, this is only the beginning.
Quote.author: Club management

Hero.title: Central City Stadium
Hero.description: The stadium where victories are born — the heart of football in Zhytomyr, with a history spanning more than seventy years.

Timeline.heading: Stadium history
Timeline.description: From its first opening to a full modern reconstruction — the story of our home arena.

events.title: Stadium founded
events.description: The stadium first opened its gates to supporters in the centre of Zhytomyr.

events.title: Olympic-era reconstruction
events.description: The east, north and south stands were completed, significantly expanding the arena's capacity.

events.title: Years of decline
events.description: Without sufficient funding, the stands gradually fell into disrepair and the venue became harder to maintain.

events.title: Transferred to the city
events.description: Ownership passed to the local community, paving the way for a full-scale rebuild.

events.title: Grand reopening
events.description: After a complete reconstruction, the stadium reopened with a capacity of 5,928 seats.

events.title: Top-flight football
events.description: The arena regularly hosts Ukrainian Premier League and Cup matches.

Facilities.heading: Infrastructure
Facilities.description: Everything a modern match day needs — for players, media and supporters alike.

items.title: Four stands
items.description: The stadium combines four stands with a total capacity of 5,928 seats.

items.title: Natural pitch
items.description: A regulation-size 105 × 68 m pitch with quality drainage and natural turf.

items.title: Floodlighting
items.description: A modern lighting system allows matches to be played in the evening.

items.title: Media zone
items.description: Dedicated press facilities, commentary boxes and an interview area.

items.title: Medical room
items.description: An emergency medical point and doping-control rooms in line with UAF requirements.

items.title: CCTV & security
items.description: A video surveillance and access-control system to keep supporters safe.

Location.heading: How to get there
Location.description: The stadium sits close to the centre of Zhytomyr — reachable by public transport or by car.

Gallery.heading: Photo gallery
Gallery.description: A closer look at the arena — the stands, the pitch and the atmosphere of match day.
